cloud_access: read-only file extraction and low-priority parameter hashing; no service restarts/config writes

v1.3.0.rate_scope: observed completed hands in terminal traces only; screenshot denominators may differ

v1.2.0.rate_scope: observed completed hands in terminal traces only; screenshot denominators may differ

screenshot_analysis.inference_status: conditional diagnostic only; independence, equal opponent pool and time coverage unverified; no preregistered causal promotion claim

time_seat_sensitivity.method: same UTC trace-completion hour and initial seat; min(arm counts) overlap weights; resample whole hours; widen for unresolved ties
time_seat_sensitivity.limitations: observational sensitivity analysis, not randomized; opponent difficulty and account rating unavailable; hour is trace persistence time, not authoritative match start

limits: Do not pool local selfplay and online ranked means as the same estimand
Do not exclude completed games from failed batches based on batch status; operational faults and unknown outcomes are reported
Displayed all-time counts and cloud traces do not fully align; do not add them together
Platform ratings are contextual observations, not interchangeable with linear rank scores
Opponent identities/ratings and authoritative tie rules absent from stored MJAI protocol

scope.estimand: complete deployed policies, including different calibration settings

linear_rank_score.interpretation: linear presentation of the same rank data, not platform rating/Elo or additional evidence

version_scorecard.interpretation: An inconclusive gate does not erase an observed benefit or demonstrate equality. Evidence applies only to the stated opponent population and deployment.

cloud_checkpoint.provenance: Read-only SSH, CPU weights_only torch.load, canonical parameter-byte hashing; stdout captured during this analysis

local_checkpoints.algorithm: sorted parameter names + dtype + shape + contiguous raw bytes; excludes optimizer/config/summary
